newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dutch fan dies at big German rock concert.
newsitem.headline: Dutch fan dies at big German rock concert.

text.p: A 16-year-old Dutch girl died and around 300 rock fans received medical treatment at a concert by one of Germany's top bands, police said on Sunday.
A police spokesman said the girl, from the town of Kerkrade, appeared to have suffered circulatory failure at the concert by the Tote Hosen group.
Around 60,000 people attended the stadium concert in the western city of Duesseldorf on Saturday night.

Most of the other victims required treatment for faintness or dizziness as pogo-dancing fans surged together during the punk band's songs. Twenty-three people were still being treated in hospital on Sunday.
The spokesman said the number of medical cases was normal for such a big event, which was held in the band's home city to celebrate their 1,000th concer
